scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/compliance-engine && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w packages/compliance-engine && npm run build -w apps/web
